name: Phylloquinone
description: Phylloquinone (CAS 84-80-0 ), commercially recognized as Vitamin K1, is the naturally occurring form of vitamin K derived primarily from plant sources. It functions as a bioactive nutrient in food fortification and pharmaceutical formulations. This compound is also utilized in cosmetic preparations where coagulation-related and skin-conditioning activity is required. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it is formulated into injectable solutions, oral capsules, and tablets. These products target vitamin K deficiency and anticoagulant reversal protocols. Food and infant formula producers use it to fortify products to meet regulatory nutrient reference values across major global markets. In cosmetic formulations, it is incorporated into eye creams, serums, and post-procedure skincare products. These applications target the appearance of dark circles and bruising through topical delivery systems. Clinical nutrition manufacturers also include it in parenteral and enteral nutrition products requiring complete micronutrient profiles. It is supplied as a viscous oil in its pure form for various industrial uses. Emulsified and water-dispersible formats are available for aqueous formulation systems. Standard grades include USP , BP , and Ph. Eur. , supporting pharmaceutical and clinical nutrition applications. Food-grade material meeting FCC specifications is available for dietary supplement and fortified food production.
